text: Ten fictional nonprofit programme passages with eight quote variants each, for citation-checker testing.

passages.source_passage: The mid-term evaluation of the Tamsel Valley Playgroup Network found that 42 playgroups were meeting weekly by March 2023, against a target of fifty. Attendance averaged 18 children per session, and caregivers reported that toddlers were spending more time on shared reading at home. Facilitators completed three refresher trainings, although the second was shortened because of flooding. The network did not reach families in the upland hamlets, where travel times exceed two hours on foot. Only 61% of caregivers interviewed could name two age-appropriate play activities, which suggests that home-visit messaging needs strengthening. Evaluators recommend that the remaining budget be redirected toward mobile sessions rather than new venues.

passages.source_passage: In 2023, the Sahaya Matri Trust extended clinic outreach to 26 villages across the Kesharganj Hills, supported by your grant. Our auxiliary midwives conducted 3,140 antenatal visits, an increase of 22% on the previous year. Skilled attendants were present at four out of every five recorded births. However, the mobile ultrasound unit was not operational for seven weeks during the monsoon, and some referrals were delayed. No maternal deaths were reported among enrolled women, although two newborns died of complications linked to prematurity. Next year we plan to train twelve more community midwives and to open a waiting room at the Bhorkot health post.

passages.source_passage: Monitoring Report, Quarter 3: Between July and September 2024, the Lindo Basin Net Campaign distributed 48,600 long-lasting insecticidal nets across nine health zones. Household registration was completed in every zone except Mabeki, where access roads were washed out. Spot checks in 300 randomly selected homes found that 83% of nets were hanging correctly over sleeping spaces. Teams did not observe nets being used for fishing, a problem flagged in the previous round. Stock records at the Kanoro warehouse showed no discrepancies above the agreed tolerance of two percent. Volunteers will revisit Mabeki in November once the bridge is repaired, and a hang-up campaign will follow in December.

passages.source_passage: Board update, June 2025. The Harrowmere Seed Resilience Project has now enrolled 1,250 smallholder farmers on the Ostra plateau, up from 900 at the start of the year. Trial plots of short-cycle sorghum yielded roughly 30% more grain than local maize under the same rainfall. Farmers did not adopt the drought-tolerant cowpea variety as quickly as expected, mainly because seed prices rose twice in six months. The seed bank in Velka village is now managed entirely by a women's cooperative. Management is not requesting additional funds at this stage, but asks the board to approve a reallocation of £40,000 from training to seed subsidies.

passages.source_passage: Session 4: Home Visits. In the Mbaruku District Health Programme, each community health volunteer is responsible for about 60 households. Before the session, remind participants that visits should last no longer than forty minutes, so that families are not kept from their work. Volunteers check every child under five for danger signs, including fast breathing and inability to drink. If a child has a fever lasting more than two days, the volunteer must refer the family to the nearest dispensary. Volunteers should never give out antibiotics, even when a caregiver asks for them. Spend at least 25 minutes on role-play, pairing new volunteers with those who joined in 2022.

passages.source_passage: During the 2024 school year, the Puente Alto Scholarship Fund supported 214 girls attending secondary schools in the San Lorenzo Cuchumá region. Retention was strong: 196 scholars completed the year, and 38 graduated, the largest cohort since the programme began in 2017. Mentors met each scholar at least once a month to review grades and attendance. We did not meet our target of placing ten graduates in teacher-training colleges; only six secured places, largely because entrance exams were moved forward. Many families told us that the transport stipend made the greatest difference, since many scholars live more than 12 kilometres from school. No scholarships were withdrawn for disciplinary reasons.

passages.source_passage: This mid-term evaluation covers the Safe Passage Case Management Service in Kerewa Camp from January 2023 to June 2024. Caseworkers opened 1,870 cases, of which 64% involved unaccompanied or separated children. Most new cases were referred by community leaders to block volunteers. Evaluators found that referral pathways to medical and legal partners were clearly documented and widely understood by staff. However, survivors of gender-based violence were not always interviewed in private spaces, because only two consultation rooms were available. The service has never had a dedicated interpreter for the Tarvi language, and several families said they did not fully understand their case plans. The evaluation recommends recruiting three additional female caseworkers before the end of 2024.

passages.source_passage: Background. The Orsava lowlands have experienced three consecutive failed rains since 2021, and staple prices in Dunmere market have risen by 47% over the same period. A household survey conducted by the Kestrel Relief Alliance in February 2025 found that one in three families was eating only one meal a day. Many women reported selling household assets to pay for food. Most households do not own livestock that could be sold to cover shortfalls. Government safety nets reach fewer than 2,000 of the estimated 9,500 eligible households in the district. Markets remain functional and traders have not reported supply shortages, which makes unconditional cash transfers a feasible response. The proposed programme would provide monthly payments to women heads of household for twelve months.

passages.source_passage: Module 2: Water Point Committees. By the end of this module, volunteers should be able to explain how the Neru Springs Water Project chose its 14 borehole sites. Each committee has seven members, and at least three must be women. Remind participants that committees collect a monthly fee of 500 shillings per household to fund repairs. Do not let the session turn into a debate about the fee level; this was agreed with village councils in 2023. Explain that latrines must be built at least 30 metres from any borehole. Volunteers are not expected to repair hand pumps themselves, but they should report breakdowns to the area mechanic within 48 hours.

passages.source_passage: Thanks to your continued support, the Quiet Harbour Counselling Service delivered 2,460 individual sessions in 2024 across the Fenmoor and Ashgrove districts. Our lay counsellors, trained over twelve weeks, led 85% of these sessions under supervision from two clinical psychologists. Clients completing at least six sessions showed an average fall of nine points on the distress screening scale. Waiting times were not reduced as planned; the average wait rose to 19 days after one counsellor left in August. We never turned away a client in crisis, and all urgent cases were seen within 24 hours. In 2025 we will pilot group sessions for young carers at three secondary schools.
